answer.markdown: You must use httpOnly cookies. Storing JWTs in localStorage is unsafe because any JavaScript on the page—including malicious code injected via XSS—can read and exfiltrate the token. httpOnly cookies are inaccessible to client-side scripts, which effectively mitigates this theft vector.
